title: The Absolutely True Diary of a Part-Time Indian
author: Sherman Alexie
current_text: In 2014, the Meridian School Board in Idaho kept The Absolutely True Diary of a Part-Time Indian off the high school supplemental reading list after parents complained about profanity, discussion of masturbation and what they viewed as anti-Christian content; board members rejected a committee recommendation to retain it with parental permission.

sources.quote:
Published April 2, 2014 at 9:53 AM MDT
Facebook
Bluesky
LinkedIn
Email
Trustees at the Meridian School District in southwest Idaho have voted to remove an award winning novel from the school's curriculum after some parents complained.
The Idaho Statesman reports in a story on Wednesday that trustees voted 2-1 to keep in place a hold on "The Absolutely True Diary of a Part-Time Indian" by Sherman Alexie.
